referenceFunction.generalComment: Disposal of a rectangular ventilation duct, made of hot-dip galvanized steel sheet with 275g/m2 zinc coating, sheet thickness 1.25 mm, total weight: 12.8 kg/m2. Including average material for joining profile, slide profile, bolt clamps to join components. Stiffening profiles or internal rods to decrease the bulging and caving of the duct.
